blocked_selectors.reason: Ownership changes only via DAO directCall

Hooks unpause only via DAO directCall or POM.unpauseCrossChainTransfers; closes the MCMS queue path around empty CROSS_CHAIN_TRANSFERS_UNPAUSE_ROLE. L1 HUB ONLY — config/default_config.non_l1.json omits this row, so on a spoke chainlink_mcms can queue hooks.unpauseCrossChainTransfers() at the 3-day global delay (a spoke DAO unpause would otherwise need the L1->L2 governance hop).

POM UUPS upgrades are DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE-only and use the direct governance path. Blocking this target-blind proposal selector also prevents the queue from upgrading any future UUPS target owned by the POM.
